eyebrow: Christmas Eve services in Omaha, NE
heading: Two nights. Four services. *One story.*
lede: Every service is the same one-hour Christmas experience. Pick the time that works for your crew. All times are Central.

nights.subtitle: Three services, same experience
nights.streamNote: All three also streaming live online

whereNote: An easy drive from anywhere in the metro.
doorsText: Worship Center doors open 30 minutes before each service. Seats are first-come, first-served, and there's plenty of room.
accessText: Wednesday at 6 PM is ASL interpreted and live captioned in the Worship Center.
planText: Let us know which service you're planning on, and we'll be ready for you.
